text.autoconfig.tweakkit.title: TweakKit Settings
text.autoconfig.tweakkit.option.antiEnde: Endermen can no longer pick up or place blocks.
text.autoconfig.tweakkit.option.hideBeac: Tinted glass above a beacon hides the beam but no longer blocks its effects.
text.autoconfig.tweakkit.option.safeLigh: Lightning keeps its sound and particles but never starts fires.
text.autoconfig.tweakkit.option.instaMin: Netherite pickaxe with Efficiency V instantly breaks any glass block or pane.
Netherite pickaxe with Efficiency V plus Haste II instantly breaks deepslate and its variants.
gamerule.tweakkit.macenerfdmgplayer.desc: A mace smash from a player always deals exactly 1 HP to another player.
gamerule.tweakkit.maceplayerthorns.descr: When a player smashes another player with a mace, the victim's Thorns hit harder.
Extra Thorns damage in percent. 0 = normal, 100 = double, 150 = 2.5 times.
